decisions.subject: Receipt-eligible financial event
decisions.current_evidence: Posted positive whole-RWF payment with canonical receipt journal/snapshot; independently scoped Rwanda inbound evidence. Stored confirmation is distinct from external settlement verification.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve the exact trusted ingestion/verification/allocation/posting chain that establishes receipt eligibility.

decisions.subject: Balance definitions and timing
decisions.current_evidence: Per-member/per-collection confirmed RWF and collection confirmed RWF are posting-time snapshots; later payments/reversals change independent current balances.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve these names/definitions for members and whether group totals may be disclosed.

decisions.subject: Payer, allocated member and recipient
decisions.current_evidence: Current SMS creation uses the active allocated account-independent member identity for the payment collection, enabled group policy and enabled member consent. App-linked members use existing push.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve the allocated member as primary recipient when payer differs, and define ambiguity/contact-change handling.

decisions.subject: Consent and group-total disclosure
decisions.current_evidence: Existing consent records method/enabled/revision; existing SMS body includes member and group balances. Dedicated language/disclosure approval is not recorded by the simple consent switch.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve explicit consent/disclosure requirements and choose whether primary SMS may include a group total.

decisions.subject: Exact primary receipt text
decisions.current_evidence: Fixed buri_munsi.payment_received version1 renderer and immutable body/destination/snapshot hashes.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve or replace the retained exact wording without rewriting existing receipt evidence or recreating a primary receipt.

decisions.subject: Supported language and fallback
decisions.current_evidence: The current fixed renderer uses Kinyarwanda wording with Balance/Ref labels; there is no approved per-member SMS language/fallback contract.
decisions.decision_needed: Choose approved languages, reviewed translations, member-language source and fallback behavior.

decisions.subject: Historical paused/missed-receipt recovery
decisions.current_evidence: New local pause semantics preserve eligible queued work; historical reconciliation deliberately returns CATCHUP_POLICY_PENDING and creates nothing. Current contact/consent cannot reconstruct historical revisions.
decisions.decision_needed: Choose the authorized lookback, historical/current consent rules, snapshot/date wording and review needed before catch-up.

decisions.subject: Reversal, correction and approved resend
decisions.current_evidence: Reversals use compensating journals and new snapshots. Existing primary receipts remain immutable. Safe cancellation stops pristine queued work only.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve separate linked correction/resend policy and wording; avoid replacing primary receipt evidence or treating SMS recall as possible.

decisions.subject: Uncertain outcomes and exposure
decisions.current_evidence: Unknown transport/callback outcomes retain original action identity and do not authorize replay; recorded observations are distinct from delivery.
decisions.decision_needed: Approve permitted evidence, escalation and human resolution for unknown outcomes before any retry/resend authority.
